sources.label: scripts/host_requests.py trust()
recipes/host-request-lane.md
sources.text:
The tracker trusts an issue only when the owner account wrote it: `author_association` `OWNER`,
Anything else is listed as untrusted and can never be claimed.

controls.answer: The lane calls an item the owner's own only if all four checks pass: the association is OWNER, the user is of type User, the item was not made through a GitHub App (the field exists and is null), and the login equals the repository owner. It fails closed on any missing field; labels and titles never grant trust.
The lane trusts an item whenever author_association is OWNER and user.type is User; whether it came through a GitHub App or who the repository owner is does not matter.
trust() requires user.type to be Bot and accepts any author_association, because a GitHub label such as host:workstation grants trust to the requesting host.
